review_state: photo-supported D34.12-to-D37.11 owner copper route through a registered via and counted D37 solder pad; electrical continuity unmeasured
package_basis: The two seven-contact D34 rows and board-edge mounting hole are registered in d34-cross-face-contact-fit.json. Count pin12 as the third contact down on the right component-image column, approximately (3332,2396).
front_observation: Uninterrupted exposed front copper leaves D34.12, descends beside the package, bends right below it, and terminates at the open annulus near (3418,2985). The neighboring vertical trace and resistor joints are separate.

cross_face_registration.interpretation: Both lower holes have similar projected residuals (about -8 to -13 px in x and +18 to +19 px in y), consistent with local extrapolation beyond the D34 contact-row fit. This supports, but does not electrically prove, the same-hole match.

six_control_affine.fit_controls: four D34 corner contacts, independent board-edge mounting hole, and neighboring lower open hole (3528,2918) to (684,2577)
six_control_affine.interpretation: The six-control fit uses no coordinate from the video via and predicts its solder annulus within about 4 px. This raises the same-hole match from a broad candidate to a strong photo registration, still pending electrical verification.

solder_observation: The open annulus near (795,2642) has uninterrupted narrow B.Cu to the fourth contact down on the right column of the lower-row D37 DIP14 solder field near (2045,2620). No junction with the neighboring parallel traces is visible. The earlier generic filled-joint description missed this identifiable package pad.
next_inspection: With power removed, meter D34.12 and front hole (3418,2985) to solder annulus (795,2642) and counted D37.11 solder pad (2045,2620), then check isolation from D103.11/D57.9/CLK_123M and D35.4/D42.10. A semiconductor-path reading is inconclusive without copper isolation.

d37_pad_registration.identity_basis: Both component views show the marked КР1533ЛА3 immediately beside the red-black-black-gold 20-ohm R57. The complete 200445914 view fixes the bottom-facing notch, pin8 on the left top contact, and pin11 as the fourth left contact down. The partial 200418174 view repeats that package and neighboring R57.
d37_pad_registration.solder_identity_control: The mirrored field is immediately left of the independently registered D38 solder columns x2078/x2244, matching D37 immediately right of D38 on the component view. The line from D34 terminates at the fourth right-column cap, D37.11.
d37_pad_registration.remaining_limit: No DMM continuity across the via or full route has been measured.

physical_decision: The archived two-face images support the complete D34.12 front trace -> near via -> B.Cu corridor -> counted D37.11 solder pad. Keep the electrical continuity flag pending until a power-off ohmmeter measurement confirms it and checks isolation from CLK_123M.
